title: Two seeded 2-planes of a closed locally planar set are equal or meet only at 0
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let S ⊆ ℝ^P be a closed set such that every p ∈ S with p ≠ 0 has δ > 0 and a 2-dimensional linear subspace Q of ℝ^P with S ∩ B_δ(p) = Q ∩ B_δ(p). Let Q₁, Q₂ be 2-dimensional linear subspaces of ℝ^P, let p₁ ∈ Q₁ and p₂ ∈ Q₂ with |p₁| = |p₂| = 1, and let δ₁, δ₂ > 0 with S ∩ B_δ₁(p₁) = Q₁ ∩ B_δ₁(p₁) and S ∩ B_δ₂(p₂) = Q₂ ∩ B_δ₂(p₂). Then Q₁ = Q₂ or Q₁ ∩ Q₂ = {0} (Q₁ ⊓ Q₂ = ⊥).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (Q₁ Q₂ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (p₁ p₂ : Euclid P) (δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ), IsClosed S → (∀ p ∈ S, p ≠ 0 → ∃ (δ : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < δ ∧ Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 ∧ S ∩ ball p δ = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball p δ) → Module.finrank ℝ Q₁ = 2 → Module.finrank ℝ Q₂ = 2 → p₁ ∈ Q₁ → ‖p₁‖ = 1 → 0 < δ₁ → S ∩ ball p₁ δ₁ = (Q₁ : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball p₁ δ₁ → p₂ ∈ Q₂ → ‖p₂‖ = 1 → 0 < δ₂ → S ∩ ball p₂ δ₂ = (Q₂ : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball p₂ δ₂ → Q₁ = Q₂ ∨ Q₁ ⊓ Q₂ = ⊥
